floor_history.headline: Re-confirmed the banked floor-6 candidate (fixed a D_800A35DC type conflict), classed the residual (2 source-level + 2 operand-only real hunks, 26 masked), and killed 3 natural respellings of the sele

De-smelled the selection_sound block to an honest same-variable form (score 6 unchanged); named the GCC branchless-fold mechanism that kills all isolated-test-variable spellings; identified hunk 9's j

frontier.hypothesis: Hunk 9's jtbl_80015A0C table-offset residual (target lw v0,0(at) vs ours lw v0,24(at)) closes once the hand-transcribed jtbl_80015A0C array is deleted from src/text1a_b_mid_rodata.c in the same change that lands func_800747D8's real switch as committed C, mirroring the already-executed func_8006B578/jtbl_80015988 precedent.
frontier.mechanism: GCC 2.7.2 emits a switch's ADDR_VEC into the .rodata of the TU containing the switch (build/src/text1b.o); with the hand array still present in text1a_b_mid_rodata.c, the two tables coexist and the sandbox's isolated single-function build sees a placement/offset conflict rather than the real target layout.
frontier.next_probe: When assembling the final submission (not a src/text1b.c-only session): delete the jtbl_80015A0C array (and its header-comment TODO) from src/text1a_b_mid_rodata.c in the same commit as func_800747D8's C body, then re-measure with sandbox --disable all --diff to confirm hunk 9 closes with zero bb2.ld edits, exactly as it did for func_8006B578.

frontier.hypothesis: Hunk 17 (target lbu v0,100(v0) vs ours lbu a0,100(v0), a pure register-seat choice) may resolve automatically once hunk 9's table-placement issue and the switch's real ADDR_VEC are both in place, since the current a0-vs-v0 split is entangled with the same block's branch shape.
frontier.mechanism: unconfirmed - register allocation for this load may shift once the surrounding switch dispatch is compiled from real C rather than scored against a stand-in hand array
frontier.next_probe: Re-run sandbox --disable all --diff on the same-variable candidate AFTER the text1a_b_mid_rodata.c migration (frontier item 1) lands, before spending a session on register-seat levers for hunk 17 in isolation.
